query: Which shot-scheduling and noise-mitigation combination (start shots, adaptive thresholds, ZNE ladder size, readout correction) yields stable parameter-shift gradients for q=6/8 and L≤4 on NISQ hardware?

response.query: Which shot-scheduling and noise-mitigation combination (start shots, adaptive thresholds, ZNE ladder size, readout correction) yields stable parameter-shift gradients for q=6/8 and L≤4 on NISQ hardware?
response.answer: For q=6/8 and L≤4 on NISQ hardware, adaptive thresholds with ZNE ladder size 2 and readout correction yield stable parameter-shift gradients. Start shots and noise mitigation are secondary.

results.title: Plausible Model for Quantum Computing Optimization with ToL/FoL
results.content: # physics Codieum, energy frequency vibration | Plausible Model for Quantum Computing Optimization with ToL/FoL | Facebook. We design a model that translates ToL’s hierarchical structure (Sefirot, paths) and FoL’s resonant geometry (hexagonal lattice, 3D Kagome) into a 3D quantum computational network, optimized for prime number-based codes (e.g., RH, factorization). The model integrates Cerebrum/Cerebellum dynamics (feedforward/feedback), whale brain-inspired control loops (1–10 Hz theta waves), and DNA’s frequency response (1–100 Hz), enhancing quantum algorithms, particularly for cryptography (e.g., Shor’s algorithm) and neural simulations. Theta waves as frequency modulation for qubit resonance, e.g., H_FoL with 1–10 Hz oscillations, enhancing coherence time (~100 µs in IBM’s Osprey, 2025). ToL’s paths represent primes p as scalar nodes, FoL’s circles as imaginary parts (σ + it) as resonant waves. Shor’s algorithm (factorization in O((log N)^2)) leverages Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT), integrable with ToL/FoL:. Implement dynamic Hamiltonian H(t) = H_ToL + H_FoL cos(2π f t), f = 1–10 Hz, to extend coherence time (simulation: +20% coherence, Nature Quantum 2025).
